primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-relative-cycle-functoriality (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 964-970

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Flat pullback preserves the specialization identity by the specialization-flat-pullback lemma; restriction is the special case of flat pullback along an open immersion; base change is handled by transitivity of base change, which unwinds the specialization condition for the pulled back family into the one for the original family composed with the DVR morphism; proper pushforward is covered by the specialization-proper-pushforward lemma (source lines 972-977)
